patthana21.55:1.1: na dassanena pahātabbaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:2.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nabhāvanāyapahātabbaduka nasanidassanattike bhāvanāyapahātabbaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:3.1: na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bhāvanāya pahātabbo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:4.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nadassanenapahātabbahetukaduka nasanidassanattike dassanenapahātabbahetukaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:5.1: na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbahetuko sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:6.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nabhāvanāyapahātabbahetukaduka nasanidassanattike bhāvanāyapahātabbahetukaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:7.1: na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:8.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasavitakkaduka nasanidassanattike savitakkaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:9.1: na savitakkaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakko sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:10.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasavicāraduka nasanidassanattike savicāraduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:11.1: na savicāraṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avicāro sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:12.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasappītikaduka nasanidassanattike sappītikaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:13.1: na sappītikaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appītiko sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:14.1: hetuyā tīṇi. napītisahagataduka nasanidassanattike pītisahagataduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:15.1: na pītisahagataṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca napītisahagato sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:16.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasukhasahagataduka nasanidassanattike sukhasahagataduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:17.1: na sukhasahagataṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasukhasahagato sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:18.1: hetuyā tīṇi. naupekkhāsahagataduka nasanidassanattike upekkhāsahagataduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:19.1: na upekkhāsahagataṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naupekkhāsahagato sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:20.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nakāmāvacaraduka nasanidassanattike kāmāvacaraduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:21.1: na kāmāvacaraṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakāmāvacaro sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:22.1: hetuyā tīṇi. narūpāvacaraduka nasanidassanattike rūpāvacaraduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:23.1: na rūpāvacaraṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca narūpāvacaro sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:24.1: hetuyā tīṇi. naarūpāvacaraduka nasanidassanattike arūpāvacaraduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:25.1: na arūpāvacaraṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naarūpāvacaro sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:26.1: hetuyā tīṇi. napariyāpannaduka nasanidassanattike pariyāpannaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:27.1: na pariyāpannaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca apariyāpanno sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:28.1: hetuyā tīṇi. naniyyānikaduka nasanidassanattike niyyānikaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:29.1: na niyyānikaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyyāniko sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:30.1: hetuyā tīṇi. naniyataduka nasanidassanattike niyataduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:31.1: na niyataṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyato sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:32.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasauttaraduka nasanidassanattike sauttaraduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:33.1: na sauttaraṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sauttaro sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:34.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasaraṇaduka nasanidassanattike saraṇaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.55:35.1: na saraṇaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana21.55:36.1: na araṇaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana21.55:37.1: na saraṇaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighañca na araṇaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.55:40.1: na saraṇaṃ na anidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ adhipatiyā ekaṃ avigate ekaṃ.
patthana21.55:41.1: na saraṇaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana21.55:42.1: na saraṇaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā: tīṇi. nahetuyā ekaṃ naārammaṇe tīṇi naadhipatiyā tīṇi noavigate tīṇi.
patthana21.55:45.1: sahajātavārampi paccayavārampi nissayavārampi saṃsaṭṭhavārampi sampayuttavārampi vitthāretabbaṃ.
patthana21.55:46.1: na saraṇo na sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo araṇassa sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo:. na araṇo na sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo araṇassa sanidassanasappaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo:.
patthana21.55:47.1: hetuyā dve adhipatiyā dve avigate dve.
patthana21.55:48.1: yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomampi paccanīyampi anulomapaccanīyampi paccanīyānulomampi gaṇitaṃ evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ. paccanīyānulomadukattikapaṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. paccanīyānulomatikadukapaṭṭhānaṃ nakusalattikahetuduke kusalattikahetudukaṃ
